content.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
content.note: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration (covering the previous calendar year). Calls conducted during development of guidelines up to and including 2023.

experts.name: Hijazi Ziad
declarations: Ongoing research funding from public and/or not-for-profit organisations (started in 2023 or continues in 2023): Hjärt-Lungfonden (The Swedish Heart-Lung Foundation), The Swedish Society for Medical Research, Uppsala University Hospital.
Payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, including travel funding related to these activities.
Companies listed in declarations: Boehringer-Ingelheim (Atrial Fibrillation), Pfizer (Atrial Fibrillation), Bristol Myers Squibb (Atrial Fibrillation), Roche Diagnostics (Atrial Fibrillation).
